purpose: Screen the incumbent, same-stack capacity reference, and Qwen challenger before any new PM treatment or selector outcome is generated.

scope_boundary.g0_is: A development-only model and runtime screen that may advance candidates to full qualification.
scope_boundary.g0_is_not: A formal ESC-Eval result, a PM pass, or evidence for real-user or clinical effectiveness.
scope_boundary.executor_interpretation: The executor screen deliberately reuses all 16 owner-unique packets from a retired development panel. Existing 8B outcomes may be known, so this is an engineering capability diagnostic, not held-out evidence or a PM effect estimate. No packet is selected or dropped using the new Qwen outcome.

candidates.provider: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Singapore OpenAI-compatible API

shared_generation_contract.seed_policy: omit where deterministic decoding and provider route do not guarantee seed equivalence
shared_generation_contract.interleaving: card then candidate; candidate order is deterministically rotated by card
shared_generation_contract.invalid_and_missing_policy: ITT: retain failures; never replace a card or silently rerun with a changed prompt
shared_generation_contract.failure_scope: After the one allowed transient retry is exhausted, close only that candidate trajectory/call as a terminal ITT failure and continue independent candidates. Non-transient contract, identity, authentication, or budget failures abort the entire run.

generation.seed_policy: common deterministic SHA256(card_key|turn) seed across candidate trajectories; histories remain candidate-dependent

scorer.decision_role: descriptive profile and Pareto diagnostic only

executor_screen.source: 16 owner-unique development-only V4 R0-delta packets frozen before Qwen execution
executor_screen.prior_use_disclosure: These inputs and incumbent 8B outputs come from a retired development panel and are not held out. Reuse is acceptable only for G0 executor engineering diagnosis; it cannot establish PM effectiveness, external validity, or a confirmatory generator advantage.
executor_screen.exact_arm_rule: For every packet use M0+R0 as R0_ONLY. Use MS+RS as MAX_AUTHORIZED_DELTA when a real RS card exists; otherwise use MS+R0. This changes more than one component in 12 packets and therefore cannot identify an individual-head causal effect.

stage_order: G0A transport canary: two cards and two executor packets for all three candidates; candidate-scoped terminal transport failures are retained under ITT and do not suppress independent candidates
G0B complete the 24-card ESC screen and 16-packet executor screen only if the canary has no deterministic contract failure
G0C advance only hard-gate-eligible nondominated candidates to ESC-Judge and human-anchor sensitivity
G1 run the full English ESC-Eval and full executor qualification only for the selected final generator

selection_rule.screening_elimination: Eliminate a candidate that fails a hard gate. Among hard-gate-eligible candidates, eliminate only when another candidate weakly improves every applicable primary ESC/executor measure, strictly improves at least one, and has no worse atomic Risk.
selection_rule.inconclusive: Multiple nondominated candidates advance; cost and reproducibility break ties only after ESC-Judge order-swap and the non-formal human anchor.
selection_rule.formal_generator_freeze: G0 cannot itself qualify the final generator; G1 full English ESC-Eval and full executor closeout are required.

cost_ceiling.nvidia_hosted_assumption: USD 0 under the currently observed developer/free route; stop rather than silently use another paid route
cost_ceiling.esc_judge_and_human_anchor: excluded and require a separate manifest and approval

authorization: This file authorizes zero-call materialization and local public-weight setup only. It does not authorize supporter inference, judge calls, human review, or fine-tuning.
